# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 75 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 75

**1** Jesus said: "Many are standing at the door, but it is the solitary ones who will enter the bridal chamber."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- **ⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲟⲥ** / *monachos*: "solitary ones" — the same word as in the Prologue; the unified, single ones who have made the two one
- **ⲛⲩⲙⲫⲱⲛ** / *numfōn*: "bridal chamber" — the sacred union; in Valentinian Gnosticism this is the highest sacrament
- "Standing at the door" — the many who have gathered but are not transformed
- The contrast: *monachos* (singular, unified) vs. the crowd at the door
- Cross-reference: Saying 16 ("they will stand as solitary"), Saying 49 ("blessed are the solitary and chosen")
